def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    nominal_return = 0.08
    tax_rate = 0.20
    inflation_rate = 0.025

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    after_tax_return = nominal_return * (1 - tax_rate)
    after_tax_real_rate = (1 + after_tax_return) / (1 + inflation_rate) - 1
    answer = round(after_tax_real_rate * 100, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
